baseline_models.focus_anchor: The emphatic identification at focus words 2-4 joins an utterance in construct with a messenger and qualifies that carrier as noble.
baseline_models.mechanism: The saying is not presented as free-floating content. Articulation supplies a transmissible payload, the messenger relation assigns a carrier, and nobility marks the quality of that relay.

activation_trace.role: Audibly expressed speech supplies the payload whose attribution is being traced.
The messenger-message relation makes mediation, rather than autonomous authorship, the organizing function.
Praiseworthy nobility and generosity characterize the bearer and raise the relay above a neutral conduit.

changed_reading.before: A noteworthy statement is simply being identified.
changed_reading.after: An articulated message is identified through an honored carrier, so the mode and quality of transmission belong to the assertion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus construct attributes qawl to a rasul rather than merely reporting that a messenger happened to speak.
baseline_models.mechanism: A word with social force, borne by an envoy and reinforced by the envoy's nobility, can function as delegated action. On this reading the utterance does something under commission, not merely describe something.

activation_trace.role: A title-holder whose word takes effect activates performative force inside qawl.
Envoyhood supplies the delegation relation through which the word can carry another's authority.
Noble excellence supplies standing appropriate to an effective commissioned utterance.

changed_reading.before: The verse labels a report by a respected speaker.
changed_reading.after: The verse presents an envoy-borne speech act whose force comes with its commissioned and noble mediation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Sentness and generosity coexist inside the messenger-plus-noble construction at focus words 3-4.
baseline_models.mechanism: The messenger releases rather than hoards, willing giving describes the manner of transfer, and preciousness describes what the sender entrusts to that carrier. The saying can therefore be received as a bestowed communication.

activation_trace.role: Earnest concern gives the saying an intentional concern for what it addresses.
Release and dispatch make the messenger the path by which held content becomes available.
Willing giving supplies a non-coercive and open-handed manner of delivery.
A highly valued person or thing makes both carrier and entrusted content precious within the relation.

changed_reading.before: The messenger owns or originates a saying.
changed_reading.after: The messenger releases an entrusted and valuable communication as a willing gift, while still remaining its immediate bearer.

context_deltas.mechanism: Wrapping gathers a whole into a compact state; a written sheet gives content a preservable surface; opening and spreading reverse the compression. Coupled to sentness and articulation in the focus, the messenger's saying becomes a coherent payload carried in and unfolded at delivery.

activation_trace.role: Articulated speech is the final expanded state in which the carried content becomes audible.
Dispatch supplies the transport phase between compact possession and public release.
Circular wrapping with parts gathered together supplies the compacted starting state.
A written sheet supplies a stable carrier on which content can remain ordered.
Opening, spreading, and branching supply the delivery phase as decompaction into availability.

structural_cues: The movement from wrapping in 81:1 to opening written surfaces in 81:10 reverses containment into exposure before the focus attribution.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies wrapping, a written surface, spreading, sentness, and utterance; I add the arrow that transport preserves a compact payload which delivery unfolds. The live alternative is that the cosmic and documentary scenes remain independent of the focus attribution.

changed_reading.before: The messenger simply voices a statement.
changed_reading.after: The messenger carries content in a coherent compressed form and makes it available by unfolding it into speech.

context_deltas.mechanism: What normally anchors stability is displaced, and what normally concentrates material value is left functionless. Against that collapse, calling the messenger noble relocates durable worth from possession and fixed structure to faithful mediation.

activation_trace.role: Messengerhood supplies the relational service that remains valuable when ordinary anchors fail.
Dearness and high value make karim the focus term through which worth can be re-ranked.
Elevated solidity supplies the ordinary image of immovable stability.
Removal and displacement cancel the normal stability supplied by the mountain image.
A camel at ten months of pregnancy supplies concentrated reproductive and material value.
Vacancy and disabling strip that valued possession of its ordinary use and claim on attention.

structural_cues: The early sequence removes both physical stability and prized utility, while 81:19 still asserts karim as a live value term.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies displaced solidity, abandoned high-value livestock, and a noble messenger; I infer a contrastive revaluation in which transmission outlasts possession. The alternative is that karim is only a conventional honorific with no contrast to the earlier losses.

changed_reading.before: Karim reports the messenger's conventional rank or good character.
changed_reading.after: Karim names a form of worth that survives the collapse of fixed structures and prized possessions: the capacity to bear the message.

context_deltas.mechanism: A killed and socially suppressed person is placed in the grammatical position of being questioned about guilt, reversing the expected direction of accusation. Publicly carried speech then functions as restoration: the noble relay makes the buried claim hearable rather than leaving it under the killer's attribution.

activation_trace.role: Speech circulating among people supplies the public field into which a suppressed claim can return.
The messenger relation supplies an accountable carrier for the restored testimony.
Nobility and generosity make attention to the silenced claim part of the relay's ethical quality.
Questioning and demanding an answer supply the forensic speech situation.
Guilt supplies the disputed charge whose ownership the question destabilizes.
The taking of life supplies the violent suppression that the later carried speech counteracts.

structural_cues: The branchless و ء د occurrence at 81:8 supplies only the structurally silenced victim position; no mapped root or branch identity is assigned to it.
The passive question followed by the passive killing clause reverses attention from alleged guilt toward the act done to the victim.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a silenced victim position, questioning, guilt, killing, public speech, and messengerhood; I infer that noble transmission can restore suppressed testimony. The alternative is that 81:8-9 demonstrates judgment without specifying any function of the focus messenger.

changed_reading.before: An honored bearer delivers unspecified content.
changed_reading.after: The bearer's nobility can include carrying into public hearing the claim of one whom violence and accusation had made unable to speak.

context_deltas.mechanism: Written records are spread, a cover is stripped away, and each self comes to know what it has made present. The focus branch in which a thing 'says' by indicating lets qawl name not only vocal sound but the intelligible disclosure that the messenger articulates from an exposed record.

activation_trace.role: A thing's saying through indication allows evidence itself to participate in the semantic field of qawl.
Messengerhood converts distributed indications into a relayed and addressable communication.
The written page supplies durable inscription rather than transient sound alone.
Published writing supplies the move from stored record to readable disclosure.
Removal of a cover supplies exposure of what had structured perception while remaining unseen.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the successful uptake of the exposed signs.
Presence and witnessing make prior acts available as immediate evidence.

structural_cues: A run of passive unveilings culminates in the active cognition of 81:14, turning spectacle into readable accountability.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies writing, publication, uncovering, knowledge, presence, and qawl-as-indication; I infer that the messenger voices a record already made legible across signs. The live alternative keeps qawl exclusively vocal and treats the preceding disclosures only as its subject matter.

changed_reading.before: The saying asks to be trusted because of its speaker.
changed_reading.after: The messenger articulates a disclosure whose truth is also made legible in opened records, exposed structures, and present evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The post-focus predicates extend the messenger profile through assembled strength, proximity to a governing center, stable authority, enablement, obedience, and trust. Together they turn noble from general praise into a chain-of-custody credential: the carrier has access, capacity, authorization, reception, and fidelity.

activation_trace.role: Messengerhood supplies the custody role whose credentials the following predicates elaborate.
Noble excellence is the initial summary quality unpacked into operational credentials.
Strength assembled like cord strands supplies capacity to bear the entrusted payload without failure.
Nearness and presence supply direct access to the governing source.
The stable support of authority supplies the institutional center from which commission proceeds.
Enablement and established power supply authorization and effective placement.
Obedient response supplies recognition of the messenger's effective commission within the source domain.
Security and settled trust supply fidelity at the final custody checkpoint.

structural_cues: The uninterrupted adjective sequence in 81:19-21 keeps elaborating the messenger rather than opening an unrelated description.
The order moves from capacity and source-proximity to reception and trust.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies capacity, proximity, authority, enablement, obedience, and trust; I organize them as custody checkpoints that support accurate relay. The alternative is that they are independent status honors without a transmission mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The verse asks the reader to accept an honorable messenger's word.
changed_reading.after: The verse exposes a credentialed transmission chain in which access, capacity, authorization, reception, and trust secure the messenger-borne word.

context_deltas.mechanism: An audience-known companion is cleared of covered cognition and placed as the seer of another figure at a distant but disclosed horizon. This spatial and relational arrangement opens a two-position relay: a witnessed messenger is encountered by a familiar companion who can carry the encounter into the audience's speech-world.

activation_trace.role: Expressed speech supplies the audience-facing end of the relay.
Messengerhood supplies the figure encountered at the source-facing position.
Long association supplies audience-side familiarity with the human bearer.
Mental covering is explicitly negated, clearing the companion as a competent witness.
Direct sight supplies encounter rather than hearsay at the relay's upstream edge.
The distant horizon supplies separation between witness and encountered figure without making the latter inaccessible.
Manifest disclosure supplies perceptual clarity across that distance.

structural_cues: The audience possessive in 81:22 and the object pronoun in 81:23 create relational positions that need not collapse into one speaker.
Negated mental covering precedes asserted sight, pairing witness competence with witness access.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a familiar companion, negated mental covering, sight of an object, distance, and clarity; I infer two relay positions and movement from encounter to audience. A live alternative assigns the pronouns differently or treats the companion's sight only as corroboration, not as a distinct relay stage.

changed_reading.before: One respected speaker is the sole visible source of the saying.
changed_reading.after: The saying can traverse a witnessed two-position relay, joining a source-facing messenger to an audience-known companion rather than collapsing all agency into one voice.

context_deltas.mechanism: The hidden is precisely the kind of precious content that could be monopolized, while the context negates withholding. This operationalizes the focus's generosity branches: noble mediation is not ornamental rank but a policy of making entrusted, inaccessible knowledge available.

activation_trace.role: Earnest concern makes disclosure responsive to the recipient rather than self-display by the speaker.
Willing giving supplies the positive transmission behavior opposed to withholding.
Generosity supplies the focus trait that the later negation turns into a concrete practice.
Preciousness explains why hidden content would be vulnerable to monopolization.
Concealment from sight supplies the inaccessible content that needs mediation.
Hoarding is negated, defining faithful mediation as release rather than private retention.

structural_cues: The explicit negation in 81:24 turns a possible character defect into a denied transmission failure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hiddenness, negated withholding, willing giving, and generosity; I infer that karim describes disclosure behavior across the relay. The alternative is that 81:24 qualifies a different relay participant, though the non-withholding function can still characterize the chain as a whole.

changed_reading.before: Karim is a ceremonial compliment attached to the messenger.
changed_reading.after: Karim is enacted as refusal to hoard precious hidden knowledge: the noble relay gives what it has been entrusted to carry.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context repeats qawl but replaces positive messenger attribution with a negated rival attribution marked by severance, rebellion, expulsion, and conjecture about the hidden. The focus claim therefore works as source discrimination under adversarial alternatives, not praise alone.

activation_trace.role: The positively attributed utterance supplies the candidate whose provenance is being tested.
Messengerhood supplies the accepted source class against which the rival is evaluated.
Noble excellence supplies a positive source signature, not merely pleasing content.
False speech or false attribution activates the precise provenance failure that the negation excludes.
Distance and severance supply a rival source cut off from the authorized relation.
Expulsion supplies exclusion from the trusted source domain.
Conjectural speech about the hidden supplies an epistemically weak counterfeit to the witnessed relay.

structural_cues: The exact root repetition at 81:19 and 81:25 creates positive and negative genitive attributions for the same kind of payload.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated qawl, positive envoy attribution, and a negated disconnected and conjectural source; I infer an adversarial provenance test. The alternative is a simpler polemical denial with no general authentication mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The verse positively praises the speaker of a message.
changed_reading.after: The verse identifies an authenticated source path while exposing false attribution and disconnected conjecture as rival provenance failures.

context_deltas.mechanism: A question interrupts the hearer's current way, reminder re-presents what was absent from attention, desire supplies motivational pull, and straightness supplies a corrected trajectory. The focus qawl therefore acts as a navigational intervention sent to reorient agency, not as detached information.

activation_trace.role: Earnest concern makes the utterance purposive toward the hearer's condition and direction.
Dispatch supplies a message moving outward in order to affect a recipient's course.
A path, place, and adopted method supply the trajectory put under question.
Reminder supplies the cognitive return that can interrupt an unexamined route.
The self's attraction toward an object supplies motivational movement rather than cognition alone.
Straightness and balanced alignment supply the corrected course toward which the message points.

structural_cues: The sequence question, reminder, willing, and straightening moves from disrupted motion to possible reorientation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a questioned path, reminder, motivational attraction, straightness, and a sent utterance; I add the causal arrow that hearing can redirect the recipient. The alternative is that the closing verses merely describe choice after the message without assigning the message a reorienting function.

changed_reading.before: The messenger delivers propositions for assent.
changed_reading.after: The messenger delivers a directional intervention that recalls, attracts, and makes a straighter course available without erasing the hearer's willing.

context_deltas.mechanism: Human willing is named, straightening is an active rising into alignment, and that will is nested within a higher willing associated with cultivation, completion, nourishment, and growth. This activates a reading in tension with pure command: the noble message works gently to cultivate consent while its possibility remains sourced beyond the recipient.

activation_trace.role: Gentleness and deliberate pace supply a mode of address compatible with cultivated rather than forced response.
Willing honor and assent supply the relational tone of a response freely taken up.
Will directed toward an object supplies recipient agency with a determinate orientation.
Resolve and rising to an undertaking supply active uptake rather than passive compliance.
The paired willing occurrences supply nested agency, with human willing held inside a prior enabling will.
Cultivation, repair, and completion supply a developmental mechanism for straightening.
The non-dominant growth branch supplies nourishment as an exploratory material model for enabled agency.

structural_cues: The human willing of 81:28 is retained and then nested, not merely deleted, by the doubled willing construction of 81:29.
This consent model coexists in tension with the delegated-authority baseline rather than resolving it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies human willing, active rising, nested higher willing, cultivation, and growth; I infer that the message enables and nurtures willing alignment. The live alternative reads the nesting chiefly as dependence or constraint, leaving little role for a gentle cultivation mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The envoy's force secures compliance from outside the hearer.
changed_reading.after: The noble envoy's message can cultivate a willing rise into alignment, even while that willing remains nested within a higher source of possibility.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it transfers bodily and dawn imagery into speech; it remains anchored in articulated qawl, the messenger's smooth movement, and the explicit breath-opening sequence of 81:17-18. Downstream prose should present it only as an acoustic-temporal analogy, not as a lexical replacement for messenger or saying.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus utterance and the messenger's mode of movement permit a model of speech emerging across a threshold.

activation_trace.role: Audible articulation supplies speech as breath-shaped emergence.
Smooth easy movement supplies the unobstructed passage of the emerging utterance.
Thinning darkness at the night's edge supplies the threshold from concealment to expression.
First light supplies the temporal arrival of intelligibility.
Breath leaving the interior supplies the material analogue for voiced release.
Dawn opening like breath joins temporal disclosure to vocal emergence.

changed_reading.before: The saying arrives as a completed verbal object.
changed_reading.after: The saying emerges like dawn exhaled across the edge of concealment, with the messenger carrying its smooth transition into audibility.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is branch-distant because it uses the non-dominant mapped inventory behind focus qawl and combines it with material carrying images. It remains anchored at focus word 2, sentness at word 3, preciousness at word 4, and the packet's wrap-and-open sequence. Render it only as a transport analogy for integrity in transmission, never as the literal gloss of qawl.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus construct can support an image in which a precious content is lifted and carried by its messenger.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant image of lifting and carrying materializes qawl as a load borne intact.
Dispatch gives the carried load a directed route from source to recipient.
Preciousness explains why preserving the load's integrity matters.
A bundled load gathered for carrying supplies the compact transport form.
Opening and spreading supply unpacking at the destination.

changed_reading.before: Qawl is an abstract proposition associated with a messenger.
changed_reading.after: Qawl can be pictured as a compact precious load that the messenger lifts, transports without loss, and opens for its recipients.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation is surprising because it retains a non-dominant mapping from the sight root to a narration branch. It remains anchored by the explicit seeing scene, manifest disclosure, qawl, and messengerhood. Downstream prose must call it a split-root activation that models conversion of encounter into report, not a literal claim that the sight verb means narration here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus saying can be read as the report-stage of an encounter carried through a messenger relation.

activation_trace.role: Articulated speech supplies the report produced from the encounter.
Messengerhood supplies the relation that carries encounter into communicable report.
Direct sight supplies the experiential input to the model.
The non-dominant narration branch supplies the exploratory conversion from seen event to transmitted report.
Meaning disclosed by speech or sign supplies continuity between visual evidence and verbal explanation.

changed_reading.before: The saying and the vision are separate claims that merely support each other.
changed_reading.after: The saying can be modeled as a narrated transformation of a manifest encounter, preserving a path from sight through relay into speech.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This spatial model is surprising because it uses the non-dominant upright-column branch attached to the 81:21 root and combines it with raised-throne imagery. It remains anchored in the focus messenger's sentness and utterance plus the immediately continuing location predicates. Render it only as an exploratory geometry of mediation, not as the lexical meaning of the obedience adjective.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A sent messenger adjacent to a raised governing source can be spatially modeled as a conduit between source-height and audible delivery.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech supplies the lower, recipient-facing output of the conduit.
Being sent forth supplies directed movement from source toward recipients.
A raised canopy supplies the upper spatial pole associated with governing source.
Enablement supplies the conduit with an effective and authorized position.
The non-dominant upright-column image supplies vertical continuity between the two poles.

changed_reading.before: The messenger is a person with high status near authority.
changed_reading.after: The messenger can be pictured as an authorized upright conduit through which source-height becomes recipient-facing utterance.

strongest_changes: The attributes of 81:20-21 turn noble messenger from a generic honorific into a credentialed chain of custody with access, capacity, authorization, reception, and trust.
The negated withholding of 81:24 converts generosity from status language into an operational commitment to release precious hidden knowledge.
Opened records, removed covers, and present knowledge activate qawl as intelligible indication as well as vocal utterance.
The closing path, reminder, willing, and straightening sequence makes the saying a redirective intervention while preserving a coexisting cultivated-consent model.
summary.what_was_special: The focus remained stable as an utterance-messenger-nobility construction while context repeatedly changed what each relation does. Noble could mean durable value after material collapse, ethical restoration of suppressed testimony, authenticated custody, or non-withholding generosity. Qawl could remain voiced speech while also becoming unfolded payload, legible indication, provenance-tested report, and directional address. Authority and cultivated consent remain deliberately unresolved coexisting readings, and split-root materializations were retained only with explicit containment.
remaining_uncertainties: The pronoun relations in 81:22-24 may support two relay positions, but alternate referent assignments can compress the chain.
The fold-and-open, dawn-breath, compact-load, and vertical-conduit mechanisms may be reader-supplied analogies rather than intended cross-context links.
Non-dominant mappings sharpen sight-to-narration, carried-load, growth, and verticality models, but their form distance requires downstream qualification.
The closing nested wills can foreground enabled agency, dependence, or constraint; the packet does not force one causal balance.
